name: MLAE-EIS (Suzuki et al. 2020)
description: Suzuki et al. 2020 (Quantum Inf. Process. 19, 75) run exactly as in the paper: exponentially incremental sequence m_0 = 0, m_k = 2^(k-1) for k = 1..M, N_shot = 100 shots per circuit, exact global maximum-likelihood estimate. The benchmark scale fixes only M, via the deepest circuit 2^(M-1) <= n_max.
